discount range is within the discount rate used for ship transport of 5–10% (Apeland et al., 2011b; Aspelund et al., 2006; Decarre et al., 2010; Nam et al., 2013; Roussanaly

option is also used in this study. The volume of temporary storage should be similar as the cargo volume of the largest ship in use (Skagestad et al., 2014; ZEP, 2010). This
assumption is also used in this study.
